name: @aussieljk/singlefile
description: Vite plugin to bundle a React app into a single HTML file

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/plugin.ts --outdir dist --format esm --sourcemap --external esbuild-wasm --external fflate --external vite && bun x tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:ui: cd ui && bun install && bun run build
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:ui
scripts.check: bun run workflows:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build:all

author: Lucas Knight
